question: How is the mantra element positioned within the seed of desire?
premises: It is placed in the middle of desire.
It is enclosed within the womb of desire.
inference: The element is nested concentrically within the kāma seed.
uncertainties: kāma may refer to the bīja syllable or to desire; kept as desire/seed contextually
plain_english: Placed in desire, placed in the middle of desire, and enclosed in the womb of desire.
